mapper.insert: INSERT INTO extreme_fishing_score (user_id, best_score, best_caught_fish, best_perfect_count, best_max_combo, best_puffer_mistakes, achieved_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bestScore}, #{bestCaughtFish}, #{bestPerfectCount}, #{bestMaxCombo}, #{bestPufferMistakes}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE extreme_fishing_score SET best_score = #{dto.score}, best_caught_fish = #{dto.caughtFish}, best_perfect_count = #{dto.perfectCount}, best_max_combo = #{dto.maxCombo}, best_puffer_mistakes = #{dto.pufferMistakes}, achieved_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ( best_score < #{dto.score} OR (best_score = #{dto.score} AND best_puffer_mistakes > #{dto.pufferMistakes}) )
mapper.select: SELECT s.best_score AS score, u.nickname AS nickname FROM extreme_fishing_score s LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.best_score DESC, s.best_puffer_mistakes ASC, s.achieved_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, s.best_score AS score, NULL AS secondaryScore FROM extreme_fishing_score s LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.best_score DESC, s.best_puffer_mistakes ASC, s.achieved_at ASC
